title: Product rule for the Euclidean divergence at points of differentiability
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ, g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ and x ∈ ℝⁿ such that φ and g are differentiable at x: div(φ•g)(x) = φ(x)·div g(x) + Dφ(x)[g(x)], where div G(x) := Chapter02.euclideanDivergence G x = trace(fderiv ℝ G x) and Dφ = fderiv ℝ φ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n) (x : Rn n), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (fun y ↦ φ y • g y) x = φ x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x + fderiv ℝ φ x (g x)
